map.随机名字生成器，一键生成中文名、英文名、网名昵称或游戏 ID，纯前端运行、数据不: The random name generator creates Chinese names, English names, online nicknames or game IDs with one click, running purely in the frontend with no data uploaded.
map.姓名 = 姓氏库随机抽样 1 个 + 风格字库随机抽样 1~2 个；每个候选名字: Name = 1 random draw from the surname pool + 1-2 random draws from the style character pool; each candidate name is drawn independently, so generating N names means N independent draws from the candidate space (duplicates allowed)
map.候选空间 = |姓氏库| × |风格字库|（单字或双字），中文名常见规模在万级到: Candidate space = |surname pool| x |style character pool| (one or two characters). Chinese name pools commonly run from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands; when generating 10-50 at a time the repeat probability is low but real, so duplicates are a normal random phenomenon rather than a defect. Style tags (classic/literary/ancient/modern/cute) decide which character pool is used; the "modern" style has an extra chance of degrading to a single-character name, so name length naturally varies within the same style. Results are only for naming inspiration: before formal use, still check for duplicate names, bad homophones and enterprise name registration rules.
map.项目代号与宠物名：组合词根生成易记代号，用于内部系统或社群。: Project codenames and pet names: combine word roots to generate memorable codenames for internal systems or communities.
map.用户名与昵称：在注册受限时产出可用变体，避开已占用名。: Usernames and nicknames: produce usable variants when registration is restricted and avoid already taken names.
map.头脑风暴辅助：给定主题批量产出，打破命名僵局。: Brainstorming aid: generate in bulk from a given theme to break naming deadlocks.
map.：词根填「云、枢、擎」，风格「组合」，生成「云枢、擎云、枢擎」等；「云枢」适合做: : enter the roots "yun", "shu", "qing" with the style "combine" to generate romanized forms such as "yunshu", "qingyun", "shuqing"; "yunshu" suits a scheduling middleware codename, being short and clear in meaning.
map.不保证全局唯一，仅按规则组合；正式用于产品/账号前请查重（商标、域名、平台占用）: Global uniqueness is not guaranteed; names are combined by rules alone. Check for conflicts (trademarks, domains, platform handles) before formal product or account use.
map.可在风格里指定字数上限，过长短词不便记忆，2~4 字最常见。: You can set an upper limit on character count within the style; overly long or short words are hard to remember, and 2-4 characters are most common.
